n = int(input())
b = int(input())
data = list(map(int, input().split()))

evenPrefix = [0] * n
oddPrefix = [0] * n
evenCount = 0
oddCount = 0

for i in range(n):
    if data[i] % 2 == 0:
        evenCount += 1
    else:
        oddCount += 1
    evenPrefix[i] = evenCount
    oddPrefix[i] = oddCount

diffList = []
lastIndex = 0
for i in range(1, n - 2, 2):
    if lastIndex == 0:
        x = evenPrefix[i]
        y = oddPrefix[i]
    else:
        x = evenPrefix[i] - evenPrefix[lastIndex]
        y = oddPrefix[i] - oddPrefix[lastIndex]
    if x == y:
        diffList.append(abs(data[i + 1] - data[i]))
        lastIndex = i

p = len(diffList)
arr = diffList
val = [1] * p

dpTable = [[0] * (b + 1) for _ in range(p + 1)]

for i in range(1, p + 1):
    for w in range(b + 1):
        if arr[i - 1] <= w:
            dpTable[i][w] = max(val[i - 1] + dpTable[i - 1][w - arr[i - 1]], dpTable[i - 1][w])
        else:
            dpTable[i][w] = dpTable[i - 1][w]

print(dpTable[p][b])
